description: "Custom encoding (e.g. hexlify, Latin-1, UTF-8) (platformio.ini option monitor_encoding)."

# `monitor_encoding`

- **Type:** String
- **Multiple values:** No
- **Default:** `UTF-8`

Set the encoding for the serial port. See [`pio device monitor --encoding`](../../cli/pio-device/monitor.md#cmdoption-pio-device-monitor-encoding).
